title: Amazon's Kindle will be compatible with libraries this year
summary: Amazon announced that its Kindle e-readers will become compatible with library e-books later this year. This integration will allow Kindle users to borrow digital books directly from their local libraries. The move expands the utility of the Kindle and provides greater access to content for library patrons.

title: Amazon failure takes down many sites
summary: An Amazon Web Services outage, which lasted over 24 hours, impacted numerous major websites including Reddit, Foursquare, and HootSuite. The incident highlighted the widespread reliance on Amazon's cloud computing services and raised concerns about the reliability of cloud infrastructure, prompting some companies to reconsider their strategies for redundancy. Despite the disruption, Amazon shares rose, and engineers worked to restore services while analysts underscored the rarity but not unprecedented nature of such failures.
